15+ Years Experience
EN/FR Bilingual Services
30+ Projects Delivered
"Every small business deserves a website that feels as professional and reliable as those built for global brands—without the big-agency budget. That belief is at the core of everything we build at Oui Digital." Xavier Masse Founder & Web Developer
Our Story

From Paris to San Diego: The American Dream, One Website at a Time

Bonjour! I’m Xavier, founder of Oui Digital. My connection to the U.S. started early, through years of travel and time spent between France and America. That long-standing pull eventually became a reality when I moved to San Diego in 2012 after winning the Green Card lottery. In March 2021, I proudly became an American citizen.

I began my career working on large-scale digital projects, including Nokia’s website at Wunderman, before spending six years at Siege Media (an Inc. 5000 company, six years running). There, I led front-end development and shipped performance-driven marketing websites at scale. That experience shaped my standards for speed, accessibility, and reliability—and showed me how rarely small businesses get access to that level of quality.

If you want a clear walkthrough of what we check, start here: Read the SEO audit guide
